h1: Livigno ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Livigno lies at 1,816 metres in a high valley near the Swiss border, with two mountains facing each other across the town: Mottolino on one side, Carosello 3000 on the other. Between them the operator counts 115 kilometres of slopes, served by 6 gondolas, 14 chairlifts and 12 ski lifts, with the ski area opening on Saturday 28 November.
stayOverview: The town runs the length of the valley floor with a gondola at each end: Mottolino from the southern end, Carosello 3000 from the north. A free bus connects them.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Either end puts you at a gondola; the middle of town needs the bus.
rentalCars: Livigno is reached over the Foscagno pass or through the Munt la Schera tunnel from Switzerland, about two hours from Bormio in winter.

lifts.value: Six gondolas, fourteen chairlifts and twelve ski lifts
lifts.note: The gondolas are Carosello 3000 I and II, Mottolino, Livigno Centro Tagliede I and II and Cassana. The resort lists its lifts by type rather than as a total.

verticalDrop.unannounced: No vertical drop is published on the operator’s ski-area or lift pages.

topElevation.unannounced: No top elevation is published on the operator’s ski-area or lift pages.

season.note: The span of the resort's own 2026/27 ski-pass price periods. It announces the opening date but publishes no closing day.
season.sourceLabel: Livigno: ski pass, seasons and rates 2026/27

snowpark.unannounced: The operator names its two mountains, Mottolino and Carosello 3000, but no terrain park on the ski-area or lift pages.

pistes.note: Over 100 square kilometres of skiable terrain across both sides of the valley.

baseElevation.unannounced: The resort states its slopes reach almost 3,000 m and counts its runs, lifts and 100 square kilometres of terrain, but states no base altitude on its slopes or ski-pass pages.

longestRun.unannounced: The resort counts 74 runs over 115 km and splits them by grade, and names individual runs such as the Zuelli black, but publishes no run lengths and names no longest run.

dayPass.value: Priced by period: promotional, season and high season
dayPass.note: Promotional runs 28 November to 18 December 2026 and 10 April to 2 May 2027; high season covers 26 December to 8 January and 30 January to 29 March. The resort publishes the rates themselves only inside its downloadable 2026/27 price list, not on the page.
